title: Make the LAN-wide auth bypass opt-in (ALLOW_LAN_BYPASS env flag)
description: VERIFIED: server/main.py auth_middleware lines ~108-110 bypass auth for EVERY request from 127.0.0.1/::1/localhost/192.0.2.10 and ANY 192.168.x.x host — for all /api/ endpoints (watchlist, search, stream, EPG, record, profiles), not just health. Admin + cloud-sync routes are still protected by their own per-router X-Admin-Key/X-Device-Token checks, but everything else on the LAN is open. This is a deliberate dev convenience, but it cannot be disabled without editing code. Add ALLOW_LAN_BYPASS env (default true for backward compat, set false for hardened deployments) gating the bypass, document it in config.py, and add a test that the bypass is skipped when disabled. SECURITY_AUDIT.md 'Auth Coverage 60/100' is directly affected.

title: Tighten CSP script-src (currently 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval') or document the tradeoff
description: VERIFIED: server/main.py SecurityHeadersMiddleware sets script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'. unsafe-eval is required by hls.js/shaka (WebAssembly/worker eval patterns) and unsafe-inline by React hydration, but this combination defeats most XSS mitigations. Audit whether hls.js/shaka truly need unsafe-eval at runtime (modern versions don't always); if they do, document the accepted risk in SECURITY_AUDIT.md with a rationale instead of leaving it silent.

title: Verify stream preflight latency and CDN behavior at runtime
description: VERIFIED CODE CHANGE (session 2026-07-31): preflight_stream() in server/routes/stream_core.py now opens a short aiohttp connection (status check + 1-byte read) before every live/VOD/remux/transcode/proxy StreamingResponse so dead channels return 502 instead of 200-with-empty-body. Unit + route tests added (test_stream.py, test_stream_live.py TestPreflightFailure, test_stream_vod.py TestPreflightFailure). Remaining risk: preflight adds one connection setup (~100-300ms) per stream start and consumes 1 byte of live streams. Verify against the real provider (iptv-provider.example.com) that (a) channel zapping latency is acceptable, (b) the 1-byte read does not desync mpegts.js, (c) dead channel IDs (e.g. 250, 1) now return 502 quickly.

title: StreamingRange: add HEAD/GET probe timeout tuning and preflight cache
description: preflight_stream() uses a fixed 10s timeout on every call with no cache. Under repeated channel zapping to the same stream this opens a redundant connection each time. Add a short-TTL success/failure cache keyed by stream URL (reuse _probe_cache pattern, PROBE_CACHE_TTL-style constant, e.g. 30s success / 5s failure) so rapid re-zaps skip the preflight, and make the timeout env-configurable (STREAM_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT).
